tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Mid-State maroon, exact from the college header logo SVG. Primary buttons, date pills, callout rule, masthead ring. White text on it (10:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Mid-State gold, exact from the Cougars wordmark. Accent only: 'Open to all students', slide subtitles, link text in dark theme. Never text on light grounds (1.9:1 on white — fails).

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Mid-State black (the college's rich black). Text on light-theme surfaces (`surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-callout`). In dark theme this token IS `surface` (the page background) — never used as text there; dark-theme copy uses `text` instead.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Slide and masthead ground, from the Teams slide and club page header. Paired with white and gold text.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft maroon tint from the club page's 'student-run club' notice. Callout ground in light theme.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white page ground from the club page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, event rows, content column sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-callout
tokens.usage: Callout / notice ground. Dark value is derived (maroon-tinted charcoal), not from a source.

tokens.name: masthead
tokens.usage: Masthead and slide ground in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-callout` (≥12.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, eyebrows, fine print on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-callout` (≥6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on `masthead` and on `maroon` fills.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrow labels, secondary-button text and border. Maroon on light grounds (≥8.6:1), gold on dark grounds (≥8:1) — maroon on dark fails (1.6:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill (9.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders and inputs; ≥3:1 on `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Club name on mastheads and slides. Set UPPERCASE, `text-on-dark` on `masthead`.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Slide subtitle under the name, UPPERCASE, in `gold`.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: What is on, what the club just decided

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Activity night — gaming, digital and analog

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE label above a block, in `brand-text`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The students run the Cyber Cougars.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, pill padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding-y, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Masthead padding, big gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, event rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and the page column.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Date pills only.
